text: violet: Dropped a compact-chart tweak: auto unit switching (SI), smoothing toggle, and a "Highlight top percentile" control. Quick UX + a11y pass? ben: Axis ticks look cramped on narrow panels. Proposal: use SI suffixes (ms, s, K) and round to 2 significant figures. Avoid tiny decimals like 0.00012ms. clare: Smoothing concern: short spikes disappear. We should compute extremes from raw samples and render them on a separate marker layer above the smoothed line. sam: Legend overflow idea: show compact row with color dot + initials, overflow chevron opens a menu listing series name + latest value + anomaly count. Must be keyboard accessible. clare: Marker rules: hollow 3px circle + subtle halo, color = warning token. Show markers when anomalies <=5; if >5 show a legend badge like "7 extremes" to avoid clutter. a11y-bot: A11y checklist: sparklines need an accessible name and a live summary when focused. Legend toggles require role="button" + aria-pressed. Markers must have 24px hit target and announce value + index on focus. Example live region snippet to include in docs: ``` Sparkline (requests/sec): min 2, median 12, max 420. 2 points above 95%. ``` ben: Tooltip microcopy: when overlay is active show "value (raw)"; when smoothing on show both "value (smoothed)" and "value (raw)" with a delta. figma-bot: Updated Figma with compact legend + marker examples :white_check_mark: violet: Acceptance criteria I'll add: SI units with 2 sig figs; default highlighting = on (95%); compute extremes from raw; markers <=5 else badge; aria-live summary; legend overflow keyboard-friendly; tooltips labeled raw/smoothed; perf note to keep marker layer composited. I'll update the PR and ping for final review. sam: :thumbsup:
